xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5189: File explorer D2: viewers tier 2 (Office, notebooks, Mermaid)

plan.title: File explorer D2: viewers tier 2 (Office, notebooks, Mermaid)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The explorer (PAN-5183) shows images, PDFs, audio, fonts, tables, archives and SQLite through the tier-1 viewers (PAN-5188), but Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, Jupyter notebook and Mermaid files only get the generic binary card or raw text. Parent FR-9 requires tier-2 previews for these formats.
narratives.Proposal: Port t3code's Office viewers (betteroffice engines for docx/xlsx/pptx; an ODF path through the office preview worker for odt/ods/odp) and its notebook preview, add a Mermaid viewer that renders strict-mode SVG into an img behind t3code's lexical guard, and add the office, notebook and mermaid rows to D1's viewer router before its text row. The notebook and Mermaid viewers do not depend on any Office item. Every failure falls back to the binary card. License and Effect checkpoints were resolved in planning (PRD D-1, D-2).
narratives.NonGoals:
- .rtf and .epub previews, legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt, Apple iWork files and video previews.
- Editing any Office, notebook or Mermaid file inside its viewer; the code pane Preview/Edit toggle belongs to PAN-5187.
- Running notebook code or rendering widget, JavaScript or LaTeX outputs.
- Syntax highlighting in notebook code cells.
- Mermaid rendering inside notebook markdown.
- Loading fonts or engines from a CDN.
- Mounting viewers in a pane or creating CodePane.tsx (PAN-5186, PAN-5187).
- Server changes, new HTTP routes or new RPC methods.
- Changing the frontend tsconfig.json lib, raising any lint ratchet, or raising any file-size cap.
- Using ChatMarkdown or MarkdownTab for notebook markdown (not inert).
- The phone app (apps/mobile).

autoDecisions.summary: Accept @betteroffice/fonts and fonts-cjk, licensed (Apache-2.0 AND OFL-1.1), and drop no Office format.
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent drops formats whose package is not MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD/ISC; OFL-1.1 covers only the font files and is not a code license. The rule targets copyleft code (heic-to, LGPL), and the dashboard already ships OFL fonts (Space Grotesk, Geist, DM Sans, @fontsource/jetbrains-mono). The OFL texts ship in licenses/.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep effect/Schema in the office code; rename Schema.TaggedError to Schema.TaggedErrorClass.
autoDecisions.rationale: Runtime and tsc --strict probes on effect 4.0.0-beta.73 passed for every API used except TaggedError, which beta.73 names TaggedErrorClass (already used in src/lib/overdeck/merge.ts). The type-guard fallback stays as a checkpoint.

autoDecisions.summary: Ship all five betteroffice packages including the 34 MB CJK fonts, and record before/after sizes.
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent names all five; assets load only when an Office file opens; no pack-size gate exists; engines never use system fonts, so without CJK faces CJK text is blank. Fallback: drop fonts-cjk if CI pack or release fails on size.

autoDecisions.summary: Parse notebooks on the main thread from src, independent of the office worker.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps notebook and Mermaid shippable even if Office were dropped, and handles notebooks over the 5 MiB Monaco threshold that arrive as large-text reads.

autoDecisions.summary: Render notebook markdown with react-markdown plus the inert plugin instead of MarkdownTab.
autoDecisions.rationale: MarkdownTab renders ChatMarkdown, which loads markdown images (remote fetches) and turns bare paths into file chips, with no plugin hook; saved notebooks are untrusted. The same typography class is reused.

autoDecisions.summary: Render notebook code cells as plain pre blocks.
autoDecisions.rationale: t3code uses a @pierre/diffs virtualized highlighter at a version Overdeck does not pin; plain text is readable and avoids a dependency change.

autoDecisions.summary: Pin mermaid 11.17.2 and render its SVG into an img data URL with securityLevel strict.
autoDecisions.rationale: 11.17.2 is already in bun.lock transitively, so no new package tree; an SVG in an img cannot run script or fetch.
Parent FR-9 lists only docx, xlsx, pptx, odt, ods, odp, notebooks and Mermaid.

autoDecisions.summary: Every tier-2 failure renders the binary card with the reason as its notice.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator can always download the file; this reuses D1 BinaryCard.

autoDecisions.summary: Rewrite toSorted/toReversed in ported files instead of raising the tsconfig lib.
autoDecisions.rationale: main compiles ES2022 methods but nothing on main uses ES2023 ones under lib ES2020; a local rewrite keeps the change surgical.

autoDecisions.summary: Make the browser screenshot check conditional on CodePane mounting FileViewer.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5187 owns CodePane and had not mounted FileViewer at planning time; the D1 plan used the same rule.

metadata.sizeJustification: The file count comes from porting one upstream module (t3code files/office, about 40 files with an internal worker and protocol graph) 1:1 into one new folder; items are split by engine and viewer so each lands as its own commit. The subsystem count exceeds 6 only because the lint counts each root-level file (bun.lock, each scripts/ file, each docs/ file, licenses/, changelog.d/) as its own subsystem; the code itself lives in one frontend folder. Splitting across issues would leave unreachable code in each PR, because the router row for Office needs the engines.
